data.title: Vehicle tax assessment – new rate from 1 January 2025
data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Musterhafen (customs office administering vehicle tax) has reassessed the vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for vehicle MH-BK 510 at €186.00 per year, effective from 1 January 2025, to be collected annually in advance by direct debit.
data.explanation: This letter resets your annual vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for vehicle MH-BK 510 to €186.00 starting 1 January 2025. The amount is collected automatically each year in advance by direct debit (Lastschrift), so you don't need to transfer anything yourself — just make sure your account has enough funds when the debit happens. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Hauptzollamt in writing or electronically; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and binding.

items.title: Deadline to object (Einspruch) to the vehicle tax assessment
items.action: Decide whether to file a written or electronic objection (Einspruch) with the Hauptzollamt Musterhafen by the deadline shown, if you disagree with the assessed tax amount.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the tax assessment becomes final and binding.
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
